title: studio(data): the field type catalog lacks three spec field types (user, secret, record), so a showcase field of those types reads "(not found)" in the Type control and the add-field palette never offers them
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, class (a), reach by a named real producer, measured. objectstack `examples/app-showcase` declares fields of all three types (objectstack `main` `c6fe02d7ac`):
- `Field.user` on `project.team_members` and on `showcase_field_zoo`'s `f_user`, `f_users` and `f_owner`;
- `Field.secret` on `showcase_field_zoo`'s `f_secret`;
- `type: 'record'` on `showcase_field_zoo`'s `f_record`.

Reader: objectui triage first-touch (grade and route).

Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, objectui, open + closed):
- "Studio field type catalog missing user secret record types shows not found" returned objectui#11780 (hidden system fields) and objectui#5375 (secret widget spelling). Neither is this.
- "FIELD_TYPE_META drift from spec FieldType enum" returned objectui#4687 (vector field keys). Not this.
- Positive control, same run: "field type picker 46 field types flat select no search" returned objectui#11793: yes.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat 3 (`session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`) from the objectui#11793 dev report (out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What happens

- Studio's field type catalog (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/field-types.ts`, `FIELD_TYPE_META` and `TYPES_BY_CATEGORY`) lists 46 types. `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0's `FieldType` has 49: it adds `secret`, `user` and `record`.
- Measured by the objectui#11793 dev, through the real `ObjectFieldInspector` on a one-shot probe:
  - the Type control reads "user (not found)", "secret (not found)" and "record (not found)" for those fields;
  - none of the three is offered in the type list;
  - lit control: a `lookup` field reads "Lookup" and is offered.
- The canvas's add-field palette reads the same `TYPES_BY_CATEGORY`, so it cannot add these types either (by construction, not separately measured).
- The catalog's header still says "46 entries as of spec 7.1", which is now a stale count.

## Done when

- The catalog derives from or matches the spec's `FieldType`, with a category, an icon and the designer's name and description rows for `user`, `secret` and `record`.
- A pin fails if a spec field type is missing from the catalog. That is a parity test inside the package, not a new gate.
- A `user`, `secret` or `record` field reads its type's name in the Type control.
